Oven-Roast Chicken Drumsticks

Kekava Grade A drumsticks, oiled and seasoned, roasted with the oven's core probe to 75 C.

2-3 people50 minEasy1 cook

1AssumptionsWhat I decided for you — override anything here

  • 1 kg Kekava drumsticks, about 6-8 piecesPackage states 1.00 kg, Grade A, use by 20.08.2026. Cook today; do not carry over.
  • AEG Competence has no numbered programsRotary-dial oven. Set left dial to True Fan Cooking symbol, not a program number.
  • Use oven's built-in core sensor, not surface timeAEG oven has a core temperature sensor to 99 C; drumsticks are done at 75 C internal regardless of size mix.
  • Plain salt, pepper, olive oil rubNo marinade specified. For more flavour add paprika/garlic; not included here to keep it simple.

hands-on 0:10unattended 0:4050 min

Tools and parts

  • AEG Competence built-in ovenRoasts drumsticks to safe core temp
    Fan 200 C, core probe 75 CTrue Fan Cooking symbol, left dial

3Steps

  1. 1

    Season drumsticks

    7 minrub all sides
    chicken drumsticks1.00 kg
    olive oil30 ml
    fine salt8 g
    black pepper2 g

    Pat drumsticks dry with paper towel. Rub with olive oil, salt, and pepper on all sides.

    Skin dry, evenly coated.

  2. 2

    Preheat oven

    fan 200 C12 minfan symbol dial

    Set the left dial to True Fan Cooking at 200 C and let the oven reach temperature before loading the tray.

    Oven holds 200 C.

  3. 3

    Roast drumsticks

    fan 200 Ccore 75 C30-35 min
    chicken drumsticks1.00 kg

    Place drumsticks on the wire shelf over the tray, skin side up. Insert the core sensor into the thickest drumstick, not touching bone, and set it to stop at 75 C.

    Sensor reads 75 C, juices run clear.

  4. 4

    Rest and serve

    5 minrest before cutting

    Rest drumsticks on the tray for 5 minutes before serving so juices settle back in.

    Juices stay on plate, not pooled out.

  • Core temperature must reach 75 C before serving
  • Wash hands and boards after handling raw chicken
  • Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours

1. Assumptions

What was assumed for this recipe. Override anything here:

  • 1 kg Kekava drumsticks, about 6-8 pieces

    Package states 1.00 kg, Grade A, use by 20.08.2026. Cook today; do not carry over.

    Rotary-dial oven. Set left dial to True Fan Cooking symbol, not a program number.

    AEG oven has a core temperature sensor to 99 C; drumsticks are done at 75 C internal regardless of size mix.

    No marinade specified. For more flavour add paprika/garlic; not included here to keep it simple.
